dict.string: Wockett uses the camera to detect your body position and count squat and push-up reps.
Wockett reads your step count from Apple Health to track your daily walking goal.
Wockett may write walking workout data to Apple Health when you complete a route.
Wockett uses your location to suggest nearby walking routes, track your position during in-app navigation, and calculate distances.
Wockett uses motion data to count your steps when Apple Health is unavailable.
